data: Every student of physics, irrespective of whether they wish to pursue theoretical physics or experimental physics, needs a thorough training in the core principles and conceptual structure of physics. The exposure should bring out the coherence and structure in the theories that shape our understanding of nature at all length and time scales. This course is an advanced overview of the discipline that teaches the language of physics as it is practised at advanced levels. This course will enrich and enable students so that they see experiments not as data generating endeavour but as the only way to uncover the deeper principles that seem to be at work in nature.
Classical Physics: Energy and Force II
